story.title: From a first introduction to a professional industry partner
paragraphs: In 2000 (1379), we started with a simple goal: build panels that put quality, safety, and standards first, and demonstrate the durability of the product and our commitment.
Today, across industry, petrochemicals, and residential, commercial, and office construction projects, the name Faraz Control is known for quality, engineering precision, and documented handover.
Through the design and manufacturing of industrial panels and automation, we value the growth and success of our clients.
